title: クレーンゲームに挑戦！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while out and about with Agnes Tachyon…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I think it's time you give up and drink my new concoction. I promise you, a whole new experience awaits.
choice_data_list: That claw machine over there also looks promising!
That claw machine over there also looks promising!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Don't try to change the subject—oh, wait, this might be perfect.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon's eyes glow dimly as she looks at the claw machine.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: What is essential to winning a prize in a claw machine? That's right—reaction time!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: This drink is loaded with ingredients that stimulate the A10 cell group within the brain's reward system, which as a result, will enhance your concentration.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Drink this and you can consider all the prizes yours! Now, hurry! Chug! Chug!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: You really make things difficult, my little guinea pig! Oh, and if the results aren't good, I'll have you try a different drink! All clear?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can fail now!
